notes: Priority 1 audit fixes, batch 2 (1.11.17, items 1.7-1.10 + 2.1): (1.7) unfreeze today — programme range is now state fields (programme_start/programme_end) instead of hardcoded constants; after the range ends the app shows the real today plus a post-programme banner ('programme finished — build a new programme') instead of freezing the date at 18 Dec; the range auto-extends when the programme grows (Google pull / new boxes) and the programme note shows the real range. NO first-run wizard — the app is the user's only (his explicit instruction). (1.8) backlog tab renamed to «گذشته» with undone past work on top and done past work below; the dashboard button counts undone past boxes and jumps straight to that section. (1.9) state schema + versioning — version field, allowlist of top-level keys with types for POST /api/state (unknown keys and wrong-typed values rejected), migration on load (legacy files rewritten once, migrated), and serialized frontend saves (promise queue + X-State-Seq). (1.10) backup + credential hardening — a missing/corrupt backup_meta.json is rebuilt by scanning backups/ with SHA-256 verification; a corrupt current file is preserved as <file>.corrupt-<ts> on restore instead of being silently overwritten; chmod 0600 on google_oauth.json, gemini_key.txt, b2_config.json (at write time and once at startup). (2.1) bulk test-count entry — a per-chapter grid (one number per section on one page) plus the books' known totals as checksum targets (حسابان IQ 3489, شیمی بتمن 3000; گسسته IQ and فیزیک الگو omitted — گسسته's only source contradicts itself (headline 2110 vs chapter table summing to 1479), فیزیک sources conflict; no per-section count was seeded anywhere because none is known — the TOCs list pages, not question counts — and entered counts are never overwritten). No 1.1 (localhost auth) — user dismissed it as accepted risk.
